title: IterCAD: An Iterative Multimodal Agent for Visually-Grounded CAD Generation and Editing
title_zh: IterCAD：用于视觉对齐 CAD 生成与编辑的迭代式多模态智能体
abstract_en: Computer-Aided Design is pivotal in modern manufacturing, yet existing automated methods predominantly rely on open-loop, one-shot generation, creating a mismatch with iterative real-world practices. In this paper, we present IterCAD, a unified multimodal agent framework for closed-loop, interactive CAD generation and editing. We formulate the task as a multi-turn interaction between a multimodal agent and an executable CAD sandbox, covering three tasks: Drawing-to-Code, Text-to-Code, and Interactive Editing. To support this, we develop a data synthesis pipeline incorporating advanced industrial manufacturing features to generate standard-compliant multi-view engineering drawings, complex code-editing tasks, and high-fidelity interaction trajectories. We optimize the agent via progressive SFT followed by geometry-aware reinforcement learning with viable-prefix masking to enhance code executability and geometric fidelity. Finally, we introduce the IterCAD-Bench evaluation suite and propose the Chamfer Distance Tolerance-Recall (CD-TR) curve alongside its AUC-TR metric, establishing a survivor-bias-free standard that unifies code validity and geometric precision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IterCAD achieves highly competitive performance across multiple benchmarks, significantly outperforming existing approaches in both code executability and geometric precision, while exhibiting superior capabilities in closed-loop iterative refinement.
abstract_zh: Computer-Aided Design（CAD）是现代制造的核心环节，但现有自动化方法多采用开环、一次性生成范式，难以匹配真实工业设计中的迭代式工作流。本文提出 IterCAD，一个统一的多模态智能体框架，用于闭环、交互式 CAD 生成与编辑。作者将任务建模为多模态智能体与可执行 CAD sandbox 之间的多轮交互，覆盖 Drawing-to-Code、Text-to-Code 和 Interactive Editing 三类任务。为支撑训练与评测，论文构建了数据合成流水线，引入先进工业制造特征，生成符合标准的多视图工程图、复杂代码编辑任务和高保真交互轨迹。训练方面，IterCAD 先进行 progressive SFT，再通过 geometry-aware reinforcement learning 结合 viable-prefix masking 优化代码可执行性与几何一致性。论文还提出 IterCAD-Bench 评测套件，并设计 Chamfer Distance Tolerance-Recall（CD-TR）曲线及 AUC-TR 指标，以避免幸存者偏差，统一衡量代码有效性与几何精度。实验表明，IterCAD 在多个基准上取得有竞争力的结果，在代码可执行性和几何精度上显著优于现有方法，并展现出更强的闭环迭代细化能力。
key_points_zh: 提出 IterCAD，将 CAD 生成与编辑建模为多模态智能体和可执行 CAD sandbox 的多轮闭环交互，贴近真实工业设计流程。
覆盖 Drawing-to-Code、Text-to-Code 与 Interactive Editing 三类任务，实现从图纸、文本到代码以及交互式修改的统一框架。
构建数据合成流水线，生成标准化多视图工程图、复杂代码编辑任务和高保真交互轨迹，并包含先进工业制造特征。
采用 progressive SFT 与 geometry-aware reinforcement learning，并引入 viable-prefix masking，以提升 CAD 代码可执行性和几何保真度。
提出 IterCAD-Bench、CD-TR 曲线和 AUC-TR 指标，在评估中同时考虑代码有效性与几何精度，减少仅统计成功样本带来的幸存者偏差。

llm_assessment.comment: Strong closed-loop CAD agent work combining executable sandbox interaction, synthetic trajectories, SFT, RL, and geometry-aware evaluation gates.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作将可执行CAD沙箱交互、合成轨迹、SFT、强化学习和几何评测门控结合起来，是较强的闭环智能体研究。
